findings.issue: まっぴらだ expresses flat refusal ('absolutely not / I want no part of it'), not inability. 'I'm utterly hopeless at' misreads it as being bad at physics, contradicting expl_en and lit_pt ('totalmente-recusada').
findings.current: Things like physics, I'm utterly hopeless at.
findings.suggested: Things like physics — absolutely not (flatly refused).

findings.issue: Stray tokens 青 (tokens[0]) and 色 (tokens[1]), with all-null gloss/role, sit before 服 — out of sentence order and duplicating the proper combined token 青色 at position 8. Reconstructing the sentence from token order yields garbled 青色服は…. They should be deleted.
findings.current: tokens[0]=青, tokens[1]=色 placed before 服, duplicating 青色 at tokens[8]
findings.suggested: Remove the two stray leading tokens 青 and 色; keep only the single 青色 token in sentence position.

findings.issue: In pt-BR the color adjective 'rosa' (noun-derived color) is invariable: 'as roupas eram rosa', never 'rosas'. Plural 'rosas' is an agreement error (and reads as the flower).
findings.current: As roupas eram vermelhas, rosas, azuis e assim por diante.
findings.suggested: As roupas eram vermelhas, rosa, azuis e assim por diante.

findings.issue: 'nominalization of しよう' is circular (defines しよう as a nominalization of itself) and misidentifies the form: in どうしようもない, しよう is the volitional of する (どうしよう 'what could one do' + もない).
findings.current: to do (nominalization of しよう, in the set phrase どうしようもない)
findings.suggested: to do (volitional form of する, in the set phrase どうしようもない)

findings.issue: Same circular/garbled form label as the en gloss: 'nominalização de しよう' describes the token as a nominalization of itself; しよう here is the forma volitiva de する.
findings.current: fazer (nominalização de しよう, na expressão fixa どうしようもない)
findings.suggested: fazer (forma volitiva de する, na expressão fixa どうしようもない)
